mapper.sql: select id, machine_type, spec_dimension, tire_avg_lh_stock_minimun, tire_ave_lh_stock_maximun, max_lh_class, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag, remark from t_cx_schedule_limit
mapper.update:
merge into t_cx_schedule_limit a USING (
select #{QuotaSetting.machineType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} machine_type, #{QuotaSetting.specDimension,jdbcType=DECIMAL} spec_dimension, #{QuotaSetting.tireAvgLhStockMinimun,jdbcType=DECIMAL} tire_avg_lh_stock_minimun, #{QuotaSetting.tireAveLhStockMaximun,jdbcType=DECIMAL} tire_ave_lh_stock_maximun, #{QuotaSetting.maxLhClass,jdbcType=DECIMAL} max_lh_class,
#{QuotaSetting.createBy,jdbcType=VARCHAR} create_by, #{QuotaSetting.createTime,jdbcType=DATE} create_time, #{QuotaSetting.updateBy,jdbcType=VARCHAR} update_by, #{QuotaSetting.updateTime,jdbcType=DATE} update_time, #{QuotaSetting.remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR} remark from dual
) b ON ( a.machine_type = b.machine_type and b.spec_dimension = a.spec_dimension AND a.del_flag = '0' ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET a.tire_avg_lh_stock_minimun = b.tire_avg_lh_stock_minimun, a.tire_ave_lh_stock_maximun = b.tire_ave_lh_stock_maximun, a.max_lh_class = b.max_lh_class,
a.update_by = b.create_by, a.update_time = sysdate, a.remark = b.remark WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (a.id, a.machine_type, a.spec_dimension, a.tire_avg_lh_stock_minimun,a.tire_ave_lh_stock_maximun,a.max_lh_class, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.remark, a.del_flag) values (SEQ_PUBLIC.NEXTVAL, b.machine_type, b.spec_dimension, b.tire_avg_lh_stock_minimun,b.tire_ave_lh_stock_maximun,b.max_lh_class, b.create_by, sysdate, b.remark, '0')
